visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. Built from components/site/v3. Same place-type class as /cities/[slug]/types/[type].
competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin community type filters. A dedicated community+type page with leftover/segment stats, the parent community atlas, and photographed listings of that type, instead of a search-results URL. Unique title, canonical, ItemList when listings exist. Breadcrumb is City then type, no Home.
note: Same composition as /cities/[slug]/types/[type], from that route's _v3 components. H1 `{Type} in {Place}` is the only display line; the Atlas wears an eyebrow under it; one section-0 claim sentence with its source line, single-sourced on listing_tile_mv. The page still reads the recorded boundary itself because the LIST depends on its pins (Sunriver: 52 listings by polygon, 0 by subdivision name, measured 2026-09-09); the Atlas re-reads the resort outline on its own streamed budget so one miss is not both. Communities with no trusted polygon and no resort GeoJSON (sunriver, brasada-ranch) render the standin's unavailable state instead of nothing. Unknown type notFound().

tasteReview.evaluator: Separate Agent subagent, one per class, spawned by the builder with the rubric table, the two shot paths and TASTE.md, told not to read page source; three independent scorings in the one call, median recorded. Four scoring rounds ran on this node (medians place-type 71/69/67/77, place-type-community 73/70/68/70); the recorded round is the last one, whose prompt carries no round history, matching the conditions of the 2026-09-08 table instrument.

shotSpec.capture: first viewport, scripts/take-route-shots.mjs default, scale 1, palette-quantized, next dev on the lane's own branch

tasteReview.beats: Zillow's Tetherow search shows undifferentiated MLS pins with no recorded community boundary and no property-type slice; this page draws the recorded polygon, slices to one type, states the count and the asking band in a sentence, and stamps when it read them. tetherow.com owns the photography and carries no live inventory at all.

defects.finding: The trail reads Bend then Single-family and never names Tetherow, so the one place the page is about appears only in the H1. Changing it is a schema and parity-spec change for the class and was left for a node that owns the breadcrumb.
Just listed / Went pending / Sold are three plain sentences with a dot and no encoding of the list-to-pending-to-sold spread — the least composed passage in the fold, and shared V3Atlas markup.
The four fewer-sales to more-sales swatches carry no counts, so the reader trusts a gradient instead of reading a number off it. Shared V3Atlas markup.

At 375 the legend, counts, type toggle, price scrubber and both next-actions sit below the map. Moving them above it was tried this session and scored worse on both classes because it buried the map; the answer is a compact control bar inside V3Atlas, for every caller.

The boundary fill, the roads and the dots read as neutral greys rather than the cream field and navy marks TASTE names as the Atlas reference; a crop of the map alone does not say Ryan Realty. Shared V3Atlas.
